methodology.failed_attempt_selector: agent.conversation_loop API call failed (attempt N/M), provider=openai-codex
rules: Retry attempts count separately; mirrored records, retry notices, exhaustion summaries, transport diagnostics and GUI endings do not add attempts.
The previous public boundary is the 16 September Sol report through 09:59:31.688 UTC+3.
Direct ChatGPT observations are owner reports without hidden transport telemetry and are not added to Hermes API counts.
Silence is not treated as recovery because the owner closes Hermes during dense failure periods.
